title: plugin-gantt: GanttViewMode JSDoc names four granularities, the type and toolbar honor five — 'year' missing from the doc line
body:
Observational doc drift, found while measuring the `viewMode` vocabulary for objectstack#9463 (the spec half of #5074). Filed unassigned, not claiming.

Measured on `origin/main` @ `68d9e282c83af26f639180fc22dacba4c26dc201`:

- `packages/plugin-gantt/src/GanttView.tsx:195` — the JSDoc reads `/** Timeline granularity — one column per day, week, month, or quarter. */`
- `packages/plugin-gantt/src/GanttView.tsx:197` — the type it documents is `'day' | 'week' | 'month' | 'quarter' | 'year'`
- `'year'` is fully honored, not vestigial: `VIEW_MODES` (:199) includes it, `NOMINAL_DAYS` (:207-213) maps it (365.25), the column builder branches on it (:1911 area), the toolbar renders it as a selectable mode (:3205 `VIEW_MODES.map`), and the header-band logic special-cases it (:2130, `viewMode === 'year' ? 'decade' : …`).

One-word fix in the comment line; no behavior change. Not part of #5043's undeclared-`as any`-reads family (that track is about schema keys, not doc comments), and not in #5074's wiring scope — hence its own card.
